guidance: We start at 31/80 HP against one 55-HP Punch Construct with Artifact 1. Its current intent is Defend, so this turn has no displayed incoming damage. Astra's free Battle Trance+ opener draws four cards before any other draw action. After that, maximize useful damage now, especially Perfected Strike's live 20 damage, rather than spending energy on block that expires. Artifact cancels the first debuff: do not count Bash as immediately applying Vulnerable until Artifact is removed. Recompute hand, energy and enemy block after each card. On later attacking turns compare guaranteed kills with block, and keep HP for the approaching Act 1 boss; Burning Blood heals only after combat victory. The remaining Duplicator can double the next card, but spend it only if the doubled effect prevents substantial HP loss or guarantees an earlier kill. Do not end a lethal turn while legal survival remains. On victory claim rewards and prefer reliable block, draw/energy or boss damage over weak additions; stop at the map boundary.
